kyosoku_summary — DRIVE town op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.kyosoku_summary(path=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivetown; drivetown.kyosoku_summary(path=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("kyosoku_summary"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

教則の場面の再現台帳(docs/drive/kyosoku_scenarios.json)を読み、category × status の件数表にする。

path = None なら repo の docs/drive/kyosoku_scenarios.json(このモジュールの場所から引く)。返り値 {"total", "statuses" (順序つき), "by_status": {status: n}, "categories": [...] (件数の多い順), "by_category": {category: {status: n}}, "table": [[category, n_reproduced, n_partial, n_pending, n_not_reproducible, total], ...]}。

Raises ValueError: ファイルが無い・JSON でない・scenarios が無い・場面に id/category/status が無い・ status が KYOSOKU_STATUSES に無い・id が重複。
